description: List the tenant's item categories, brands or item groups (kind=category|brand|group) with each entry's id, name, description and the number of live items that carry it. Categories are a tree: each has parentCategoryId and its full path ("Apparel > Shirts"); pass parentCategoryId to list one category's children. Groups also carry code, salesTaxId and depositFeeAmount. Optional case-insensitive search on name (and path); paged (Total pre-paging + limit/offset, default 100, max 500). Use the ids with set_item_classification and save_discount.

parentCategoryId.description: Categories only: list the direct children of this category id.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of the name (or category path).

name: list_catalog_taxonomy
